title: Ter Que and Precisar de — Obligations and Needs
module: Módulo 4 — Planos, capacidade e ações em andamento

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Tasks you need to complete this week” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Ter que + infinitive expresses obligation; precisar + infinitive or precisar de + noun expresses need.
student.structure: ter que + verb; precisar + verb; precisar de + noun
student.english_comparison: English need to differs from need + noun; Portuguese inserts de only before nouns here.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “I have to work.”?
Which sentence expresses “She needs to study.”?
Which sentence expresses “We have to leave early.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Hoje eu tenho que trabalhar de manhã. Depois preciso estudar português. Minha irmã precisa de água e de tempo para descansar. Nós temos que preparar o almoço. Você precisa comprar pão? Sim, preciso comprar pão, mas não tenho que sair agora.
questions: O que o narrador tem que fazer de manhã?
O que você tem que fazer hoje?

examples.en: Do you have to study today?

review.compare: Preciso estudar / Preciso de água: verb versus noun.

common_mistakes.explanation: Standard Brazilian use before infinitive omits de.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

items.cue: Do you have to study today?

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.
items: Do you have to study today?

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: Nós temos que sair cedo. Ela ________ estudar.
Eles precisam de tempo. Nós ________ que sair cedo.
Você tem que estudar hoje? Eles ________ de tempo.
Eu tenho que trabalhar. Você ________ que estudar hoje?
items.hint: Do you have to study today?

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Pedro tem que terminar uma atividade. Ele precisa de um livro e de uma mesa. Sua amiga precisa trabalhar até as cinco. Eles têm que estudar para a prova. Nós precisamos descansar depois do trabalho.
questions: Até que horas a amiga precisa trabalhar?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “I have to work.”? A. Eu tenho que trabalhar. B. Eles precisam de tempo. C. Você tem que estudar hoje?
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: A. Eu tenho que trabalhar. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.instruction: Eu ________ que trabalhar. (I have to work.)
B_gap_fill.worked_answer: tenho → Eu tenho que trabalhar. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: Ela precisa estudar. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: I have to work. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.instruction: O que o narrador tem que fazer de manhã?
E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: Ele tem que trabalhar. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “Nós temos que sair cedo.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: Eles precisam de tempo. — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: Você tem que estudar hoje? — say it, then change one real-life detail.

your_homework.instruction: Give independent answers and speak all written sentences once.

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: Nesta semana, eu tenho que ir ao mercado. Preciso de arroz, água e frutas. Minha irmã tem que trabalhar no sábado. Nós precisamos estudar português à noite. Os amigos precisam de tempo para terminar um projeto.
questions: Aonde o narrador tem que ir nesta semana?
Quando a irmã tem que trabalhar?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 6–8 sentences on the topic “Tasks you need to complete this week”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — O que você tem que fazer hoje? / Você precisa de água? / Você precisa estudar amanhã? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

mini_reading.translation: Today I have to work in the morning. Afterward I need to study Portuguese. My sister needs water and time to rest. We have to prepare lunch. Do you need to buy bread? Yes, I need to buy bread, but I do not have to leave now.

F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
